messages:
Sam: Quick sync — assembling the release orbit for next Wed (2026-03-25). Primary objective: keep the window to 2 hours, region-aware, and confirm smoke + rollback owners for each lane.
Lina: I can take runtime (model-serving + routing). I'll be on-call for the 09:00 PT slot.
Rohit: I'll own infra/autoscale and the API-gateway changes. Nominate @Jen as rollback lead.
Jen: Happy to be rollback lead and handoff for infra. Will be reachable on phone if needed.
Maria: I can handle Console/UI deploy at 10:00 PT. Will run the smoke checklist on staging right before.
Sam: Draft smoke matrix below — PLEASE edit inline if something wrong. Trying to be explicit about who runs the quick checks vs who triggers rollback.
```
09:00 PT | runtime (Lina)    | smoke: Lina           | rollback: Jen
09:30 PT | api-gateway (Rohit)| smoke: Rohit          | rollback: Jen
10:00 PT | console (Maria)    | smoke: Maria          | rollback: Ops-bot
```
Rohit: small ask — I'll run a preflight autoscale test 30m before my slot. If I see >5% cache miss vs baseline I'll delay for 15 mins.
Lina: noted. For runtime smoke please run the KV-check + perf quick test: 
```
curl -sS https://runtime.prod.internal/health || echo "HEALTH_FAIL"
ab -n 100 -c 5 https://runtime.prod.internal/predict?input=test
```
Maria: Console smoke will include auth sanity + one critical flow (upload -> annotate). I'll paste checklist into the runbook.
Sam: Can Deploy-bot run the standard canary at each slot start? If so, add canary threshold of 0.5% error uplift as auto-stop.
Deploy-bot: scheduled canary jobs enabled. Canary threshold set to 0.5% error uplift; will post results to #deployments and DM owners.
Ops-bot: I've registered the rollback playbooks and will pin the one-pagers under the release thread. Use `ops-bot rollback <lane>` to kick off.
Jen: small detail — if rollback is triggered, please notify the oncall channel and Ops-bot will grab the runbook.
Sam: Final asks: react with :white_check_mark: if you confirm your slot and ownership, and drop any blockers now. If any lane needs more time, speak up by EOD today.
Lina: ✅
Rohit: ✅ (will post autoscale test results at 08:30 PT)
Maria: ✅ (checklist will be in the runbook by EOD)
Jen: ✅
Sam: Great — I'll update the release calendar and ping infra for capacity reservations. Thanks all :shipit:
